role: frozen prospective distributions; no test draws or empirical feasibility claim
unit: independent joint draw of ROI/object layout/motion/event calendar/noise streams; shared simulator and base assets are fixed, not independent terrains or real road graphs

rng.master: fresh128bit secrets for each dev-extension/main/holdout namespace, persisted before generation; roots spawn independent sequences; geometry/entity/event/wind/sensor separate child streams
rng.lineage: no actual root or entity configuration is derived by perturbing an actual dev/main/holdout instance; event siblings and intervention repeats retain original lineage and sensor noise seed
rng.collision_guard: all root semantic digests and private128bit root seeds unique across namespaces; duplicates cause a finite pre-score generation error, never automatic new policy run

ID.roi: reference9vertex template envs/inspection/scenario.py ROI; sx,sy independent U[.93,.99], rotation U[-.025,.025]rad, per-vertex x/y jitter U[-4,4]m; reject only by fixed geometric predicates
ID.static_targets_per_class: independent discrete uniform {1,2} for each of3 target classes
ID.static_origins: x U[-240,240]m; y uniformly chosen from{-300,-100,100,300} plusU[-45,45]m; every static/static distance>=45m
ID.normal_count: discrete uniform{4,5,6,7}; each coordinate U[-330,330]m, same static separation
ID.dynamic_count: L1 zero; L2/L3 discrete uniform{2,3}, distinct selected survey stripe indices
ID.dynamic_motion: origin xU[-110,110]m and stripe y±15m; kth appearance discrete uniform integers110+55k..134+55k; speedU[1.1,1.6]m/s; headingU[-.12,.12]rad; radiusU[60,85]m; bend0 in analytic CaseEntity.position
ID.events_L3: priority integer160..205s; distinct random link/camera/retire drones; link startinteger200..245 durationinteger20..35s; camera startinteger290..320 durationinteger30..45s; retirementinteger350..385s; otherlevels no events

OOD.roi: new radial family,9 ordered angles2*pi*k/9 + independentlyU[-.03,.03]rad + commonU[-.15,.15]rad; independent radiusU[385,398]m; centered origin; area>=400000m2 and coordinatesabs<=400m; no affine transformation of an actual root
OOD.static_targets_and_normals: same count distributions; target origins independent uniform[-280,280]^2m, normal origins uniform[-330,330]^2m; polygon/45m guards; no ID stripe distribution
OOD.dynamic_motion: closed curved trajectories: speedU[1.1,1.6], radiusU[60,85], headingU[-pi,pi], bend1; draw circle centeruniform[-200,200]^2 and set origin=center-rotation(heading)*(0,radius); same analytic formula and full600s containment guards
OOD.events_L3: priority integer160..205s; distinct random link/camera/retire drones; link startinteger280..300 durationinteger30..40s; camera startinteger285..305 durationinteger30..45s; retirementinteger350..385s, so overlapping health/link regime is possible; L2 noevents
OOD.shift_scope: new geometry and motion family plus changed event overlap; same sensor noise, grading thresholds, 4aircraft and qualified wind envelope; no claim about real map or terrain OOD

shared.physics: same qualified core240Hz/120Hz,17m/s profile and actual hard constraints
shared.sensor: same qualified mission/protocol immutable source closure; no call-count-dependent noise, shared root/time/sensor random channels
shared.trajectory_guard: complete motion from appearance through600: polygon containment and building2m margin, groundproxy3m and report-identity45m pair separation certified by analytic speed bound on a601sample grid; pair speed bound uses |speed|*max(1,abs(bend)); all static/static>=45m; no policy outcomes in acceptance
shared.capacity_guard: with fixedS>=.6 andD>=.5 needed perfect static+dynamic reports<=10; necessary bound only, no SRsuccess guarantee
shared.draw_limit: at most1000 whole-root geometric candidates and1000 inner placements perentity; every rejection reason/candidate index retained; exhaustion blocks the namespace, no silent counts reduction/replacement based on method result
shared.population: the prospective distribution is the above joint draws conditional only on listed geometric/capacity predicates, with finite exhaustion failure; not an unconstrained geographical population

development_validation: BeforeG4 implement this exact generator and test ID and OOD families on new development-only namespaces (no actual main/holdout seeds/instances). Any failing feasibility or ambiguity guard blocksG4; do not tune ranges on main results or silently relax45m.
